name: Nix Action
description: Composite action that handles the common CI boilerplate: harden runner, checkout, Nix/Cachix setup (via setup-nix), and command execution.

cachix_cache_name.description: Cachix cache name. Empty defaults to the caller repository name (passed to setup-nix)

cachix_extra_pull_names.description: Comma-separated list of additional Cachix caches to pull (substitute) from, read-only

nix_path.description: Nix path to use (passed to setup-nix)

disable_sudo.description: Whether to disable sudo in harden-runner

persist_credentials.description: Whether to persist git credentials after checkout
